Asha (CSM): Hi all Cascade Health kickoff here. Nina wants production by mid-May (~6 weeks). Need alignment: owners, must-have success criteria, and the go-live timeline. Who's in for immediate actions? :wave:
Nina (Cascade POC): Thanks Asha. Main priorities: PHI-safe routing, low latency for triage flows, and a short runbook for our ops team. We'll need a compliance checklist too.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): Noted. Two quick asks: (1) do they want hosted or Private? Nina: "Private with VPC peering." (2) expected peak QPS? Nina: "~60 QPS with occasional spikes to 120." We'll need dedicated capacity recommendations and a perf baseline plan.
Taylor (Implementation Manager): I'll map workshops and enablement. Suggested phases: Week 0=Legal & infra prep, Week 1=Discovery + infra setup, Week 2=Integration & baselining, Week 3=Prompt/kernel tuning, Week 4=Ops runbooks + shadowing, Week 5=Final validation + go/no-go.
Evan (CS Lead): Legal/DPA is a likely blocker. Recommend we start Security questionnaire today and route the DPA through Legal this week. Also flag renewal touchpoints: ensure exec sponsor is engaged before week 3.
Asha (CSM): Success criteria proposed (let's keep measurable): ["latency p50 < 200ms at 60QPS","99.9% availability during business hours (M-F 8-18 PT)","integration test suite passes CI with mock traffic","security questionnaire reviewed and DPA signed","onboarding enablement completed & runbook published"]. I'll add them to the shared doc.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): I'll post an infra checklist fragment to the doc: ```- VPC peering + route tables
- Private subnet for inference
- Egress rules minimized (allow model registry + monitoring)
- KMS key access for model decrypt
- IAM role for Redwood runtime
- Prometheus scraping allowed for metrics
```
OnboardBot: Initial calendar invites created for Discovery (Wed 10:00 PT), Infra Deep-dive (Thu 09:00 PT), and Baseline perf test (Mon 08:00 PT week 2). Links: https://calendar.redwood.example/cascade-kickoff
Taylor (Implementation Manager): I'll spin up the enablement plan doc and a short timeline graphic. Who will lead the performance baseline?
Miguel (Solutions Eng): I'll lead baseline + capacity recs. Plan: synthetic traffic + real-sample traces, measure p50/p95/p99, tail latencies, and token cost. I'll add a short checklist for the team.
Nina (Cascade POC): For compliance, our security lead wants a SOC2 excerpt + network diagram. Evan, Asha can you share those?
Evan (CS Lead): Yes, we'll route the SOC2 summary and provide a template network diagram. I'll have that to you by EOD.
Asha (CSM): Next action list (summarized): Miguel -> infra checklist + perf baseline plan; Taylor -> enablement schedule + workshop outlines; Evan -> legal + SOC2 + DPA routing; Asha -> stakeholder RACI + success criteria into the doc; Nina -> confirm internal stakeholders and provide sample traffic. If no objections, aim for Discovery next Wed. :thumbsup:
Miguel (Solutions Eng): No objections. I'll drop the checklist in the doc now.
Taylor (Implementation Manager): Sending Doodle for recurring enablement slots.
Nina (Cascade POC): Thanks team. Looking forward to the Discovery workshop.
Asha (CSM): Great work. I'll close out with a short summary in the doc and update this thread after the infra checklist and DPA are in flight. :lock:
